text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected for customer zenova: Dedicated pool dp-zen-03 is experiencing repeated GPU node failures and rapid drains. Symptoms: repeated preemptions, thermal alarms, and NVML errors on multiple nodes. Impact: session creation failures and increased 5xx for zenova-prod routes. Severity P2. Paging on-call: @maria (oncall). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-pool-gpu-failures

maria (oncall): ACK, taking this. I'll gather impact and coordinate with dedicated-ops. tagging @carla for customer comms.

ajay (eng-sre): copying logs now. initial signal looks like a mix of spot termination notices + GPU thermal/kernel oops on gpunode-7f2b, gpunode-7f3c, gpunode-7f9a. Can someone run a quick node list?
```
# poolctl list --pool dp-zen-03 --format table
NODE            STATUS    GPU_TEMP  LAST_EVENT
gpunode-7f2b    unhealthy 92C       kernel_oops
gpunode-7f3c    unhealthy 88C       spot_termination
gpunode-7f9a    unhealthy 95C       nvml_reset
gpunode-4a1d    healthy   62C       ok
```

soph (eng-runtime): metrics: GPU temperature spikes correlate with load bursts from zenova batch jobs. NVML shows repeated ECC errors on gpunode-7f9a. Session create errors: 502 gateway for pinned instances, 1.8% error rate last 5m, time-to-first-token higher by ~220ms. Suggest immediate cordon+drain of affected nodes and fail traffic to fallback pool. Proposed routing tweak: route policy for zenova-prod -> dp-zen-03-fallback (hosted burst) until nodes replaced.

noah (dedicated-ops): confirmed two of the three failing nodes are spot-backed; cloud provider delivered termination notices for gpunode-7f3c and gpunode-7f2b in the last 10m. gpunode-7f9a shows hardware-level thermal sensor spikes — likely hardware fault. Replacing spot nodes will be quick, but gpunode-7f9a needs a hardware swap. Recommend: 1) cordon/drain the three nodes, 2) spawn two reserved (non-spot) replacements, 3) schedule hardware replacement for gpunode-7f9a, 4) enable temporary routing fallback.

carla (acct-mgr): Is impact customer-visible? Do we need to send an interim message to Zenova? If yes, I can draft.

maria (oncall): yes visible — sessions failing intermittently for a subset of customers pinned to dp-zen-03. SLA impact appears limited but rising. ajay/soph please confirm error windows and affected percentage by region. If we failover traffic it's best to notify proactively.

lee (infra): immediate mitigation steps I can kick off:
1) cordon & drain nodes:
```
poolctl cordon gpunode-7f2b gpunode-7f3c gpunode-7f9a --pool dp-zen-03
poolctl drain gpunode-7f2b gpunode-7f3c gpunode-7f9a --pool dp-zen-03 --evict-sessions
```
2) scale up dp-zen-03 with two reserved replacements:
```
poolctl scale --pool dp-zen-03 --add-instances 2 --instance-type gpu-v2-reserved
```
3) set routing override for zenova-prod to fallback pool for new sessions:
```
routectl set-override --customer zenova --route zenova-prod --target dp-zen-03-fallback --ttl 30m
```
I can run 1-2 now, will need dedicated-ops assistance for replacements.

ajay (eng-sre): running drain now. output: 
```
> poolctl drain gpunode-7f2b gpunode-7f3c gpunode-7f9a --evict-sessions
evicting 24 sessions from gpunode-7f2b... done
evicting 12 sessions from gpunode-7f3c... done
evicting 18 sessions from gpunode-7f9a... done
marking nodes unschedulable... done
```
Traffic should start rebalancing. watching metrics.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: on-call handoff reminder scheduled. Auto-updates will post every 5m.

sam (oncall-2): joining for 30m handoff. I'll run post-drain health checks and validate session create success for zenova across eu/us/asia. Maria, want me to take over once replacements are up?

maria (oncall): yes please take over in ~25m, I need to jump to another call. Current status: drained three nodes, routing override pending. error rate dropped from 1.8% -> 0.6% in the last 3m.

soph (eng-runtime): after drain we see error rate down to 0.28% and TFRT latency normalized. Still seeing degraded throughput for some pinned routes while new instances come up. Next steps: schedule hardware replacement for gpunode-7f9a (ticket infra-12345), run nvml diagnostics, and plan driver/firmware update if SMART tests fail. Also add a mitigation to the runbook: detect repeated thermal + spot mix -> auto-provision reserved fallback.

carla (acct-mgr): drafting a short customer note: "Hi Zenova team — we detected instability in your dedicated pool dp-zen-03 earlier today and have placed affected nodes into maintenance while we spin up replacement capacity. New capacity is routing to a fallback pool to keep session creation stable. We'll follow up with a maintenance schedule and RCA. — Carla, Redwood Customer Success". OK to send?

maria (oncall): OK to send now. Please include that we expect full capacity back within 90 minutes for spot replacements; hardware swap may take longer.

lee (infra): I've triggered scale and routing override. poolctl returned successful provisioning for 2 reserved nodes: gpunode-9c2d, gpunode-9c4e. Monitoring join logs.

ajay (eng-sre): new nodes joined and passed health checks. sample logs: 
```
node gpunode-9c2d joined dp-zen-03: health=ok, gpu_temp=58C
node gpunode-9c4e joined dp-zen-03: health=ok, gpu_temp=60C
```
Session creation rates improving.

sam (oncall-2): taking handoff. I'll keep this thread updated with replacement ETA for gpunode-7f9a and monitor error budget. Maria, leaving you a quick note: thanks, enjoy your call.

maria (oncall): thanks team — handoff to @sam. status: mitigation in place, error rate ~0.3%, customer notified. follow-up actions for postmortem: (a) hardware RMA for gpunode-7f9a, (b) add hotspot detection to runbook, (c) consider provider contract to avoid spot for critical pools.

soph (eng-runtime): noted for postmortem. I'll create an eval job to check quality regressions from fallback routing and add a metric alert for mixed-spot+thermal patterns.

carla (acct-mgr): sent message to Zenova (copied legal & AM). will coordinate maintenance window.

sam (oncall-2): continuing monitoring. will update once RMA ETA is in. current last_message: mitigation stable, traffic rerouted, error rate 0.31%.
